baseline.protocol: official COCOeval segm, IoU .50:.05:.95, maxDets [1,10,100]; fixed confidence .35
limitations: Small person-only domain transfer, not a general 80-class quality guarantee.
Penn train/validation scenes may share backgrounds; Fudan location is held out from fine-tuning.
No claim that upstream pretrained weights never encountered similar images.
Training uses largest external polygon per person; evaluation uses complete original pixel masks.
Dataset contains upright, relatively large pedestrians; no negative-only scenes.
AP is at deployed confidence .35, not low-threshold/full COCO model benchmark.
Matched mean IoU excludes false positives and misses; read TP/FP/FN and AP together.

protocol.selection: best.pt chosen only by the 16-image Penn validation split; Fudan test never selects weights
protocol.deployment: Candidate only. Do not replace the general 80-class production model based on person-only results.

decision: Do not promote: person mask AP improves, but small-object AP and recall regress; other classes not evaluated.
runtime: Native C++20, OpenCV 4.12 CPU FP32; both models evaluated with identical patched segmentation decoder.
